sections.overview: The World Spider Catalog now accepts Melopoeus lividus, while Haplopelma lividum is its original combination retained in this catalogue entry.
sections.identification: The older name Haplopelma lividum remains useful when consulting literature published before later generic transfers.
sections.habitat: Field observations in Thailand describe this tarantula in ground burrows, including burrows in roadside banks.
sections.diet: The catalog and field note consulted do not provide a prey list specific to this species.
sections.behavior: The field account documents burrow use, but does not quantify activity or social behaviour.
sections.reproduction: The sources consulted do not establish the breeding season or reproductive cycle.
sections.ecology: The field account confirms the use of ground burrows, including in roadside banks.
sections.conservation: The taxonomic and field accounts used here provide no species-level conservation assessment.
